title: National School of Government and Public Services

contributions.who: The Parliamentary Secretary, Cabinet Office (Mark Ferguson)
contributions.text: I am today providing an update to the House to confirm the formal establishment of the National School of Government and Public Services, following the written ministerial statement made on 20 January 2026 [HCWS1260], which confirmed the Government’s intention to establish a new national school. This marks a significant step forward in providing world-class learning and development for civil servants, supporting public sector excellence and preparing our people for the future. Reform of the civil service is central to delivering the Government’s priorities. Investing in the skills and capability of civil servants is important for improving delivery and delivering faster, higher-quality public services for the people who rely on them. The national school brings civil service learning and development under one roof, creating a unified system designed and delivered by civil servants, for civil servants. It will deliver more learning and development in house, working in collaboration with external expertise where this genuinely adds value.
